title: MQINQ: an attribute inquiry whose selectors and integer attributes are two small blocks of binary words
shapes: MQSA MQSAINQ: CALL 'MQINQ' USING WS-HCONN WS-HOBJ WS-SEL-COUNT WS-SEL-BLOCK WS-INT-COUNT WS-INT-BLOCK WS-CHAR-LEN WS-CHAR-ATTRS WS-COMPCODE WS-REASON
asserts: MQSAINQ's MQINQ CALL is one call_sites fact (resolves_to null) with a call edge and a gaps entry; the two selector words WS-SEL-DEPTH and WS-SEL-MAX are data_items (S9(9) COMP with VALUE 3 and 15).

citations.quote: The MQINQ call returns an array of integers and a set of character strings containing the attributes of an object.

gaps.name: MQINQ
gaps.why: no member of the estate holds the program
